hero.status: Alessandria, Italy · Open to remote roles and projects
hero.stage: 3D animation of a release: commit, CI, ArgoCD, Kubernetes, metrics and Terraform.
services.title: I like building things people actually use.
services.1.title: Products
services.1.text: Apps and services from the first idea to the day people start using them. Backend first, but I'm happy anywhere in the stack.
services.2.title: Tools
services.2.text: Utilities, scripts and AI helpers that take the boring parts out of the work, for my team and for me.
services.3.title: Platforms
services.3.text: The cloud underneath it all: AWS and Kubernetes that stay up, cost what they should and let teams ship on their own.
path.title: How I got here.
path.1.title: It started with servers.
path.1.text: I studied systems administration on the island where I grew up, taking machines and networks apart to see how they work.
path.2.title: Then I wrote the software.
path.2.text: At PwC I built Java and Spring Boot backends for public and private clients, worked in agile teams and learned to explain technical decisions to people who aren't technical.
path.3.title: Now I build where it runs.
path.3.text: At RatedPower, part of Enverus, I build and run the cloud platform behind Power Analyst and other energy products: Kubernetes on AWS, Terraform, observability and AI agents in production.
path.4.title: Next: things of my own.
path.4.text: From November I live in Italy, building products, tools and platforms, and working remotely.
writing.title: Notes from the work.

end.title: Let's work together.
end.text: Hiring for your team, or need a hand with a product or a platform? Write to me and I'll reply within 24 hours.
